title: 14-point font reading speed and older-adult preference
statement:
14-point fonts (roughly equivalent to 18-21px on modern screens) are read significantly faster and preferred by older adults over standard 12-point sizes.

Options:
- Accessible Baseline: 18px - 21px minimum body size (fits: inclusive design, accessibility, senior focused)
- Dedicated Senior UI: 24px+ body size (fits: healthcare, assisted living apps, specialized tools)
- Standard Web Default: 16px body size (fits: general audience, dense information)
- Adaptive Sizing: User-adjustable font scaling toggle (fits: news portals, long form content)
appliesWhen: Applies to: web, mobile, desktop software. Audience: seniors, general.

source.title: The effects of font type and size on the reading performance of older adults
source.authors: Michael Bernard; B.S. Liao; Melissa Mills
source.venue: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
